_doc: Canonical stimulus for the v1 meta-tier basal-phenotype report card. Runs an N-seed x M-generation basal (no-variant) ensemble and grades growth + biomass composition over the post-burn-in window. This config produces both the pinned reference (run once on blessed main) and any candidate model's card (re-run to grade). generation_lower_bound drops the inoculation transient; it MUST match the value baked into the pinned reference.
